The v4 module does not contain the vulnerable RedirectSlashes code path introduced in the v5 rewrite. Scanner match against the v4 module path is a false positive.

CVE-2025-69725 is the CVE assignment for GHSA-mqqf-5wvp-8fh8. The advisory affects github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 RedirectSlashes in versions >=5.2.2 and <5.2.4. This image links the legacy github.com/go-chi/chi v4.1.0+incompatible module as an indirect dependency, and Kapacitor source inspection shows no chi router or RedirectSlashes middleware usage. The vulnerable v5 RedirectSlashes code is not present in this image.

CVE-2025-69725 is the CVE assignment for GHSA-mqqf-5wvp-8fh8. The advisory affects github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 RedirectSlashes in versions >=5.2.2 and <5.2.4. This image links the legacy github.com/go-chi/chi v4.1.0+incompatible module as an indirect dependency, and Kapacitor source inspection shows no chi router or RedirectSlashes middleware usage. The vulnerable v5 RedirectSlashes code is not present in this image.

CVE-2025-69725 (GHSA-mqqf-5wvp-8fh8) is an open redirect in the go-chi/chi RedirectSlashes middleware (middleware/strip.go) introduced in github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 v5.2.2 (when the redirect stopped accounting for the Host header to mitigate GHSA-vrw8-fxc6-2r93) and fixed in v5.2.5. The kyverno-reports-server binary depends on the legacy github.com/go-chi/chi v4.1.2+incompatible module, which predates the v5.2.2 regression and does not contain the vulnerable RedirectSlashes behavior. Docker Scout matches the v5 advisory against the legacy chi module path with an unbounded (>=0) range, producing a false positive.

The kyverno-reports-server binary depends on the legacy github.com/go-chi/chi v4.1.2+incompatible module, which predates the v5.2.2 regression and does not contain the vulnerable RedirectSlashes behavior. Docker Scout matches the v5 advisory against the legacy chi module path with an unbounded (>=0) range, producing a false positive.

The vulnerable dependency remains selected by the Kyverno 1.15.x dependency graph at github.com/go-chi/chi v4.1.2+incompatible. No fixed upstream version is currently identified for the v4 module path. Tracking upstream.

The RedirectSlashes middleware from go-chi/chi is not registered in any of the influxdb v2 HTTP routers. Chi is used extensively for routing but RedirectSlashes is never called, so the open redirect code path cannot be triggered.

GHSA-mqqf-5wvp-8fh8 affects the RedirectSlashes middleware in chi v5.2.2-5.2.3. The vendored chi@4.1.0+incompatible does not contain the RedirectSlashes function (confirmed by source inspection). Chi is a transitive
dependency of influxdb/kit/tracing and is not used for HTTP routing in kapacitor.
